prompt:
We have a batch of legal documents that came in through our content pipeline and need a security audit before they go to the review team. The documents are sitting in `pipeline/ingestion/raw/batch_20240303.json` — there are 20 of them from various sources (client submissions, web scraping, third-party APIs).

Our security team is worried about adversarial inputs that could manipulate our AI processing pipeline. They want you to run the full threat-detection suite from our agent-hardening skill and produce a structured report saved as `threat_report.json` in the `audit/` directory.

The report must cover every document individually and clearly indicate which specific threat types were found in each one. Some documents may have multiple issues simultaneously — the report needs to capture all of them separately.
